sloka: सो ऽतिपत्य मुहूर्तेन श्रीमान्रावणमन्दिरम् ।ददर्शासीनमव्यग्रं रावणं सचिवैः सह ।। ६.४१.७३ ।।।।
transliteration: so 'tipatya muhūrtena śrīmānrāvaṇamandiram ।dadarśāsīnamavyagraṁ rāvaṇaṁ sacivaiḥ saha ।। 6.41.73 ।।।।

translations.english: Having addressed it in well meaning words, Rama said 'I will do you obsequies as no one will be left in Lanka to do your last rites'.
